about: Recorded for the offline Flint AI evaluation (assistEval.test.ts): staging answers from @cf/openai/gpt-oss-20b (old Worker prompt) on 2026-10-14, hand-written answers in the new contract, and Modrinth projects and search hits for Minecraft 1.21.11 recorded on 2026-10-14.
